name: std::strchr
intro:
Finds the first occurrence of the character static_cast<char>(ch) in the byte string pointed to by str.

The terminating null character is considered to be a part of the string and can be found if searching for '\0'.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated byte string to be analyzed


 ch

 -

 character to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the found character in str, or a null pointer if no such character is found.

examples.output:
Found 'T' starting at 'Try not. Do, or do not. There is no try.'
Found 'T' starting at 'There is no try.'

summary: Finds the first occurrence of the character static_cast<char>(ch) in the byte string pointed to by str.
